_about.what: What the person decided at the confirmation gate, keyed by reading id, written by the skill from what they said and read by scripts/confirm.mjs --decisions. Every key other than _about is a decision; there are no sample rows because a sample row would be applied.
_about.confirmed: "R1": "confirmed" — the reading is right as read.
_about.rejected: "R2": "rejected" — the reading is not used; nothing may cite it.
_about.edited: "R3": { "edit": "the corrected value, in the person's words" } — the reading is on the page but the person corrects the value; both the original and the correction are kept, and the correction is what the draft may cite. Only a reading the verifier found on its page can be edited: a reading that is not there is deleted from readings.json, or its value is entered in case.json as "typed".
_about.folded rows: When identical readings from several documents were shown as one row, the decision is recorded for each of their ids.
